newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Maxtel still in Zimbabwe mobile phone talks.
newsitem.headline: Maxtel still in Zimbabwe mobile phone talks.

text.p: South Africa's Maxtel Ltd said on Friday it was still involved in negotiations which if successfully concluded could have an impact on its share price.
The firm urged ordinary shareholders to continue to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made.
Maxtel said on May 13, an agreement it had reached in principle in February with Cosmos Cellular (Pvt) Ltd to set up a joint venture cellular payphone network in Zimbabwe was still being finalised.
It said Cosmos was the leading cellular service provider to the sole GSM cellular network in Zimbabwe, Net One.
